messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Marketplace buying route & procurement readiness (Atlas Health)

Hi Matt,

Great to meet you and the Atlas team on the call today — appreciate the clear context on your usage profile (real-time triage assistant, ~6M tokens/month expected ramp). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- Marketplace interest: You mentioned procurement prefers Marketplace for cataloged line-item billing but finance needs a confirmation on pricing parity and SOW-free onboarding.
- Purchase options: Two parallel paths we discussed — (A) AWS Marketplace (consolidated billing, procurement likes), (B) Direct invoice/PO (faster pilot for now).
- Security/compliance: You requested SOC 2 summary and data handling note for PHI adjacency.
- Pilot timeline: You indicated appetite for a 6-week pilot starting mid-June, pending procurement lane.

Concrete next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share a short pricing estimate and a Marketplace onboarding checklist (attached).
2) Matt — can you confirm whether Atlas requires a formal PO for pilots or if we can start on card and convert to PO for production? If PO is required we’ll route a pilot quote for PO approval.
3) Procurement team — if you’re on this thread, could you confirm two items: (a) preferred buying channel (AWS Marketplace vs vendor invoice), and (b) any vendor form or W9 contact we should expect?

I’ve attached a draft pricing estimate and SOC2 one-pager. Marissa, Ben — looping you in for pricing/marketplace questions and to own the marketplace listing follow-up.

Thanks —
Irene

--

Subject: Re: Next steps: Marketplace buying route & procurement readiness (Atlas Health)

Thanks, Irene — good recap. Quick answers:

- Procurement preference: Long term, AWS Marketplace preferred. For pilot we *may* allow a corporate card or charge card if the pilot is <$5k, but I need procurement to sign off.
- PO requirement: Production contracts will require PO and vendor onboarding paperwork. Pilot can be flexible, but need to know whether Redwood can provide an invoice and also be listed in AWS Marketplace for when we convert.
- Security: SOC2 summary looks fine from our initial review; compliance will ask for the full SOC2 report if we progress.

Looping procurement — Carla (procurement@atlashealth.com) is the right contact. Carla, can you confirm the card threshold and whether we need vendor forms/w9 before a small pilot?

Irene — can you also include an SKU or Marketplace link so our cloud ops team can see the exact item?

-Matt

Irene / Ben — quick internal note on options and what to surface when we respond to procurement:

1) AWS Marketplace path (recommended if they want consolidated cloud billing):
   - Benefits: Single-pane billing, familiar procurement workflow for Atlas, easier transition to production.
   - Caveats: Listing approval can take 2–3 weeks; onboarding requires an AMS listing (we control pricing parity); we can issue a trial/credit SKU to keep pilot low-friction.

2) Direct invoice / PO path:
   - Benefits: Fastest to start pilot (we can issue an invoice immediately).
   - Caveats: Manual billing & reconciliation; when they convert to production we’ll need to migrate them to a marketplace SKU or continue invoice-based billing.

Ask procurement for: card threshold for vendor spend, vendor onboarding packet recipient email, and whether they require full SOC2 or just the summary for pilot.

Irene — attaching the marketplace onboarding checklist and a stub quote we can convert into a PO-ready pdf. If procurement needs legal terms redlined we’ll route to Contracts.

Attachments: marketplace-onboarding-checklist.xlsx; Redwood_AMS_pricing_estimate_v1.pdf

—Marissa

Matt / Carla — thanks for the quick checks. Two follow-ups and proposed pilot cadence:

- Pilot approach: Start pilot on card / trial SKU for first 30 days (low friction). If procurement confirms PO required for any vendor spend >$2,500 we’ll prepare a PO-ready quote.
- Marketplace link: https://console.redwood.ai/marketplace/atlas-health-listing (this is the draft listing visible to cloud ops for SKU details).
- Docs: Attached SOC2 summary and the Marketplace onboarding checklist. If procurement wants the full SOC2 report we can route a reader access request via our security team.
- Next meeting: Suggest a 20-minute procurement sync this week to lock channel and payment threshold — available Wed 10:00-10:30 or Thu 9:30-10:00 PT. Which works best?

If we get a green light for card-for-pilot, our ops team will spin up a trial instance and I’ll send a short statement of work to lock the scope. If procurement prefers PO-only, Marissa will provide a PO-ready quote with payment terms.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Irene
